scope: Better real product views: live own-account technical captures plus verified archived native/web demonstrations. Only reviewed anonymous crops and synthetic examples are copied into public; uncropped sources and authenticated browser state are excluded.
authentication: Used only within an ephemeral browser process. No credential file, saved browser state, HAR or trace was created. Browser closed after capture.
transform: Rectangular crop, Lanczos downsample, WebP quality94 originals and quality91 responsive sizes. UI text, values and layout not altered.
